predictions.prediction_text: When momentum reaches an extreme as measured by the script’s 20-period mean and 1.5/2.5 standard deviation bands, the probability of mean reversion increases.
predictions.condition: price moves outside the 1.5 or 2.5 standard deviation bands (outside the Margin of Error)
predictions.expected_result: Price will reverse direction and trade back toward the 20-period rolling mean, re-entering the plotted Margin of Error band within subsequent candles.

predictions.prediction_text: Whenever the price breaks out of the Margin of Error area, that breakout reinforces the existing momentum.
predictions.condition: price breaks out of the Margin of Error area
predictions.expected_result: Price will continue moving in the breakout direction and remain outside the Margin of Error for multiple consecutive candles, indicating momentum continuation.

predictions.prediction_text: When both volatility-adjusted bands start moving up after a prior downtrend, a buy signal is generated indicating increasing bullish momentum.
predictions.condition: both volatility-adjusted bands turn upward following a downtrend
predictions.expected_result: Price will initiate an observable uptrend (series of higher highs and higher lows) while the bands continue to move up, consistent with a tradable buy signal.

predictions.prediction_text: When both volatility-adjusted bands start declining after a prior uptrend, a sell signal is produced indicating increasing bearish momentum.
predictions.condition: both volatility-adjusted bands turn downward following an uptrend
predictions.expected_result: Price will initiate an observable downtrend (series of lower highs and lower lows) while the bands continue to move down, consistent with a tradable sell signal.
